title: Build REST APIs with Spring Boot

scenes.line1: How do you build a REST API?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how to build a solid REST API in Spring Boot? Let's break down what really matters.

scenes.label: @RestController
scenes.sub: Combines controller and response body for easy REST endpoints.
scenes.say: Start with Rest Controller. It merges controller and response body, so your endpoints return JSON by default.
Validate input directly in your method with Valid. Add annotations like Not Null to your user object fields.

scenes.label: Exceptions
scenes.sub: Centralize error handling with Controller Advice.
scenes.say: For errors, use Controller Advice. It catches exceptions and returns consistent error responses for your whole API.

scenes.question: Where should you handle validation errors?
scenes.right: In a global exception handler using Controller Advice.
scenes.say: Don't handle validation errors in every controller. Use a global exception handler for cleaner, more reliable APIs.
